name: UUID Generator
description: Generate v1/v3/v4/v5/v6/v7 UUIDs and ULIDs, and inspect existing IDs.
longDescription: Generates UUIDs (v1, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7) and ULIDs, up to 1000 at a time, and inspects an existing UUID or ULID: its version, variant and embedded timestamp. Name-based UUIDs follow RFC 4122. Everything happens in the plugin; nothing is uploaded.
